user.title: Wrap a media player for HomeKit
user.description: Creates one media player that mirrors an existing one and adds a HomeKit input list. Expose the new entity to HomeKit as a Television accessory instead of the original.

data_description.name: Name of the new entity and its device, for example 'Master Bedroom Projector'.
data_description.source_entity: The player that actually launches apps; for an Android TV box this is the Android TV Remote media player.
data_description.remote_entity: Optional. HomeKit's D-pad, back, home and transport keys are sent here as Android keycodes.
data_description.device_class: Television or receiver; it only changes the icon and how HomeKit labels the accessory.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: {count} input(s) so far: {labels}. Add the apps HomeKit should list, or finish now and add them later from the entry's options.

input.title: Add an input
input.description: One app as HomeKit will list it.

data.label: Label
data.app_id: App id reported by the player

data_description.label: What HomeKit shows for this input and what the wrapper reports as its source.
data_description.launch_type: Deep link is recommended: some launchers (Projectivy on the onn 4K, for one) silently ignore package launches while deep links work.
data_description.launch_target: For a deep link, the URL the app registers, for example {example_url}. For a package launch, the Android package id, for example {example_app}.
data_description.app_id: Optional. The app_id (or app_name) the wrapped player reports while this app is in front, so HomeKit highlights the right input when the box switches app on its own. Leave empty to match on the launch target instead.

init.description: {count} input(s) configured, {overrides} remote key(s) overridden. Pick an input or a key to edit, tick 'Edit basics', or leave everything as is and submit to save. Nothing is written until you save.

data_description.input: Add a new input or open an existing one to change or delete it.
data_description.key: Open a HomeKit key to send a different Android keycode for it.
data_description.forward_remote_keys: Send HomeKit's D-pad, back, home and transport keys to the remote entity. Needs a remote in the basics.
data_description.edit_basics: Change the name, wrapped player, remote or device class.

key.description: HomeKit key '{key}' currently sends '{current}' (default '{default}'). Enter the Android keycode to send instead, or clear the field to go back to the default.

data_description.keycode: A keycode accepted by remote.send_command on the remote entity, for example DPAD_CENTER, BACK, HOME or MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE.
